finding: Compared to women with GDM aged 25-29 years, those aged 35-44 had a significantly higher risk of various adverse pregnancy outcomes, including cesarean delivery, abnormal fetal position, pre-eclampsia, macrosomia, LGA, placenta previa, anemia, and SGA.
mod_finding: This study found that pregnant women with gestational diabetes aged 35-44 years had a significantly higher risk of Cesarean delivery compared to those aged 25-29 years.
